3967-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3967-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1017-3532-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

6495-6553-7424.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6553-7424.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2073-2292-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2781-3375-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5060-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5060-5078-6792.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

224-2157-5478-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to Spelunking.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.
224-2157-5478-6973.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

628-5686-7188.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

3678-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1778-4053-5226-6989.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1355-1781-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
1355-1781-1978.description:
Cause Sanctum Weaver to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

460-527-539.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2178-6827.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2178-6827.description:
Activate Spider-Gwen by paying {2} and tapping it.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spider-Gwen ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
When the Insect dies, Spider-Gwen triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

4871-5626-6415-6797.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1069-2904.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-2904.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Equipment's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

803-2060-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}
Repeat.
803-2060-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Crystalline Crawler for additional mana.

222-527-2921-3499.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

252-997-2073--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

565-1858-3836--118.notablePrerequisites: You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-1858-3836--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2425-5231-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-5231-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-3967-4558-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-3967-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

2665-3617-4823.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Timeless Witness.
2665-3617-4823.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the token Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3836-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3836-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brokkos, adding {C}{C}.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

1669-4321-4659-4679.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Aura.
1669-4321-4659-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of an Aura you control and a Food artifact token, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog's second ability by sacrificing the Aura token, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2327-3489-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Moon-Circuit Hacker does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
2327-3489-3821.description:
Declare Moon-Circuit Hacker as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Peregrine Drake's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Peregrine Drake onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1182-2073-2866-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
1182-2073-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken noncreature artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scrap Trawler and Salvaging Station trigger.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2744-3026-4050-4302.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Angel, adding one mana of any color.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
The Spirit token becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2060-2854-3062.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
751-2060-2854-3062.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {U}.
Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1984-3041-5109.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, making it impossible for you to lose the game or have your life total reduced below 1 this turn.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Coalhauler Swine and to you, which does not reduce your life total below 1.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to each player, which again does not reduce your life total below 1.
